task2_compositional_bound.what_is_tested: with T_scan(C) := T_step(C) - T_step(noscan) the formula is an identity; the rest of the step cannot be observed at a chunk, so additivity is only testable jointly with the substitution of isolated single-call replays for the in-step scan
task2_compositional_bound.boards: E32: stock 24 GB RTX 3090, sessions two hours apart on one board; single calls: 48 GB RTX 3090, other tensors, driver 595.71.05 on both; E30: stock board, 1-2 calls per shape
task2_compositional_bound.call_mix: every captured call at the exact (L, B), equal weight, ratio of sums over calls; layers sampled every 6th (370M), 8th (2.7B), 4th (GDN)

second_session_tile_effect.note: second over first session, same call and same chunk, calls of at least 4096 tokens; the sessions ran on two boards of one host and tuned afresh, so board and tile choice are confounded; a chunk whose ratio stays near one argues against a plain board speed difference. The step effect is an arithmetic product of the scan share and the ratio, not a measurement: no whole-step run sampled the second tile choice.
